State changes take priority-always resolve them before SFC or alarms act on the system.
If in Execute, safety Suspend on Power-Loss
Record Stop Reason (Simplistic, either from an Abort Cmd or a Stop Cmd)
Internal only, don't map coil to value
When you hit an Alarm condition
1) Copy the ID value of Alarm to ds.AlmHistorian_Id2Record
When you hit an Warn condition
1) Copy the ID value of Warning to ds.WarnTimestamp_Id2Stamp
2) Copy the Warning Bit (C) to WarnTimestamp_Bit2Stamp
